HockeyAllsvenskan Team stats

Source: R/ha.R
ha_team_stats.Rd

Team stats of a season, one category per call. W / L are totals including overtime and shootout (wins_total / losses_total).

wins_total / losses_total (the site's W / L) are TOTALS including overtime and shootout results (otw, sow, otl, sol are subsets); standings' regulation_wins count regulation wins only. team_code is the display code. Only the sampled results column set is pinned in the documented columns below.

Usage

ha_team_stats(
  season = NULL,
  phase = "HA",
  category = "results",
  team_side = "all",
  team = "all",
  against_team = "all",
  all_results = "all",
  game_status = "all",
  decided_in = "all",
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025/26); the site's START-year key is sent as season - 1. NULL = the season in progress. Stats and standings start in 2005/06 (2006).

phase

Game type: HA regular season, HAPlayoff playoffs, HAkval playout (relegation series). Allowed: HA, HAPlayoff, HAkval.

category

Stats category (column set), one of results, goals, power_play, penalty_kill, penalties, offensive, defensive, faceoffs, shootouts, corsi_fenwick_pdo, stoppage_reasons, attendance. Anything else answers zero rows. Allowed: results, goals, power_play, penalty_kill, penalties, offensive, defensive, faceoffs, shootouts, corsi_fenwick_pdo, stoppage_reasons, attendance.

team_side

Home / away split. Allowed: all, home, away.

team

Team filter: all, or one team of the site's filter list (values not probed).

against_team

Opponent filter: all, or one team (values not probed).

all_results

Result filter: W win, T tie, L loss. Allowed: all, W, T, L.

game_status

Game status filter: played drops the season's unplayed games. Allowed: all, played.

decided_in

How the game was decided: ft full time, ot overtime, so shootout, wo walkover. Allowed: all, ft, ot, so, wo.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list (stamped with the request under _request where the body does not say what it answers).

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025/26).
rankintegerRank in the table.
team_codecharacterDisplay code of the team (AIK, MoDo, MORA, NVIF, ÖIK), not the StatNet id.
gpintegerGames played in the season and phase.
wins_totalintegerWins in total, overtime and shootout wins included (otw and sow are subsets).
losses_totalintegerLosses in total, overtime and shootout losses included (otl and sol are subsets).
leadingintegerGames or situations leading (StatNet 'Leading'; meaning unverified).
trailingintegerGames or situations trailing (StatNet 'Trailing'; meaning unverified).
gintegerGoals scored by the team.
gaintegerGoals against: goals allowed in the season and phase.
gfgintegerGames in which the team scored the first goal (inferred from the label; unverified).
otwintegerOvertime wins (a subset of wins_total).
otlintegerOvertime losses.
sowintegerShootout wins (a subset of wins_total).
solintegerShootout losses.
p_gpnumericPoints per game.
gpgnumericGoals for per game (number).
gapgnumericGoals against per game (number).
pointsintegerStandings points: 3 per regulation win, 2 per overtime/shootout win, 1 per overtime/shootout loss (2025 IFB: 102 + 14 + 3 = 119).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the site has nothing for the request (a season before 2005/06, an unknown or pre-2025/26 game, a phase not played, a body without rows). fastRhockey_bad_request: a value outside its enumerated set, a field the site requires is missing, or HTTP 400/422. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, or an empty, non-JSON, error-shaped, truncated or out-of-scope 200 (the answer is unknown, not empty).

See also

Other HA Functions: ha_game(), ha_games(), ha_goalie_stats(), ha_leaders(), ha_pbp(), ha_players(), ha_schedule(), ha_skater_stats(), ha_standings(), ha_teams()
